verdict.rationale: Devin's own MCP server documents a scheduling capability that supports cron expressions for recurring schedules, so this is a true recurring schedule and not just one-off execution. The feature is first-party, but the evidence comes only from short MCP tool descriptions. missing for 10: a dedicated scheduling doc covering workflow configuration, run history and failure handling, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that recurring schedules work in practice.
